title: feat: add Luciq core methods (setLCQLogPrintsToConsole, clearLogs, addFeatureFlag, removeFeatureFlag)
body:
## Summary
Brings the Flutter Luciq core module closer to RN parity by adding four public APIs:
- `setLCQLogPrintsToConsole(bool)` — iOS-only; forwards to `LCQLog.printsToConsole`.
- `clearLogs()` — clears Luciq logs via `[LCQLog clearAllLogs]` on iOS / `LuciqLog.clearLogs()` on Android.
- `addFeatureFlag(FeatureFlag)` — singular convenience wrapper over `addFeatureFlags`.
- `removeFeatureFlag(String name)` — singular convenience wrapper over `removeFeatureFlags`.

## Test plan
- [x] `flutter test test/luciq_test.dart` — 45/45 pass (4 new)
- [x] `./gradlew :luciq_flutter:testDebugUnitTest --tests "ai.luciq.flutter.LuciqApiTest"` — BUILD SUCCESSFUL (2 new)
- [x] `flutter analyze` — no new warnings
